propertyAccessReaderDefect.rootCause: aggregateSchemaCandidates called aliasInitializer on every PropertyAccessExpression. aliasInitializer trusted the property symbol's declaration initializer directly. For values typed from z.output/z.infer mapped types, TypeScript can resolve an ordinary output property back to the schema shape's PropertyAssignment, so DEFAULT_AXES.fontScale and DEFAULT_GROUP_CONFIG fields were traversed as their unrelated Zod schema initializers.
propertyAccessReaderDefect.repair: Property access now follows only a canonical variable declaration, a static property declaration, or a property found on the concrete receiver object. It no longer treats an arbitrary mapped-type PropertyAssignment declaration as the runtime value of the access.

redFirst.preFixResult: The fixture had one real owned schema but the gate inflated the denominator to two members: derived=1, twins=1, factories=0, schema-only=0. The dedicated assertion expected one member and failed.
